title: AgentWorld: A Data Factory for Training LLM Agents from Multi-Turn Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2606.09138v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training LLMs to act as capable agents requires learning from multi-turn interactions with environments. However, multi-turn interaction trajectories generated by heterogeneous agent runtimes are difficult to transform into structured, high-quality training data that training engines can readily consume. In this paper, we propose AgentWorld, a data factory that bridges heterogeneous agent runtimes and training engines through a Gateway Server and a Data Pool, reframing LLM agent training around a unified data lifecycle from interaction collection to training consumption. The Gateway Server captures multi-turn interactions through an LLM API proxy, while the Data Pool organizes them into standardized step records for curation and training. translated_title: AgentWorld：一个从多轮交互中训练大语言模型智能体的数据工厂
translated_abstract: 训练大语言模型使其成为有能力的智能体，需要从与环境的**多轮交互**中学习。然而，由异构智能体运行时生成的多轮交互轨迹，难以转化为训练引擎能够直接使用的结构化、高质量训练数据。本文提出AgentWorld，一个通过网关服务器和数据池连接异构智能体运行时与训练引擎的数据工厂，围绕从交互收集到训练消费的统一数据生命周期重构LLM智能体训练。网关服务器通过LLM API代理捕获多轮交互，数据池则将其组织为标准化的步骤记录，以便进行数据整理与训练。交互式仪表板支持轨迹监控、步骤检查和数据审查。在演示中，用户可以集成开箱即用的白盒和黑盒智能体，对轨迹进行追踪与整理……
tldr: AgentWorld是一个数据工厂，通过API代理网关捕获异构智能体运行时的多轮交互，并将其转化为标准化、高质量的结构化训练数据，为LLM智能体训练提供从交互收集到训练消费的统一数据生命周期。
en_tdlr: AgentWorld is a data factory that bridges heterogeneous agent runtimes and training engines by capturing multi-turn interactions via an API proxy gateway and converting them into standardized, high-quality structured training data, unifying the data lifecycle from interaction collection to training consumption for LLM agent training.
